task_title: G2-A: Add deterministic equipment placeholders and art-key manifest

plan_review.notes: Concern 1 (blocking): Floor 2 placeholders used dotted artKey values as pipeline briefIds, which cannot match real approved briefIds and do not bucket with them in placeholder-audit — fixed by introducing a canonical artKey→briefId helper and writing only the kebab-case briefId in manifest entries while preserving the dotted placeholder key/PNG filename. Concern 2 (non-blocking): the Floor 2 plan YAMLs claimed integration targets that do not exist in the runtime yet — fixed by removing those integration blocks and clarifying that the runtime-key contract lives in src/shared/floor2-equipment-art-keys.ts until a real consumer exists. Concern 3 (non-blocking): the branch lacked real generator-branch regression coverage and a repo-backed plan/manifest contract assertion — fixed by adding temp-dir run() tests plus committed-plan contract tests. plan_divergence=minor: the recovery added a better treatment of the integration-metadata edge case without changing the overall slice design.
